ImageDescription.value:
Name: The cemetery on Trumpeldor Street in Tel Aviv
Description: The cemetery on Trumpeldor Street in Tel Aviv was established in 1902 The cemetery was established as a result of the outbreak of the cholera epidemic in Jaffa.
